body:
Findings of the four-way review of B0/B1 (T-290, T-291) before anything is released. T-297 (the
404 floor false positive) is separate; everything else confirmed is here. Unreleased, so no field
migration concerns beyond upgrading from 3.1.0.

## P2

1. **Login is not atomic (T-260 regression).** `AuthRepositoryImpl.login` stores the token and a
   signed-in row, then calls `getSettings()`; `LoginViewModel` removes the other accounts only after
   `login` returns. A settings failure (5xx, network) leaves the previous person's account and lists
   beside a hidden signed-in new account, which the worker syncs. Also opens the window for item 2.
   Fix: inside `login`, once `/login` has answered, remove every other **server** account before
   adding/re-activating the row (local accounts, B3, are never touched); make the currency read
   best-effort. `LoginViewModel` stops calling `removeOtherAccounts`. B2's add-account path will pass
   a flag to keep the others.
2. **A list id held by two accounts collapses into one row.** `lists` is keyed by the server list
   id and `mergeList` keeps the first account's `accountId`; removing that account deletes the row
   under the other account whose cursor has already moved past it. Reachable in B1 through item 1
   and a periodic sync in the window. Fix now: item 1 closes the window; additionally, when an
   account is removed, reset the sync cursor of every other account on the same server URL so the
   next sync re-pulls. The design decision (one account per server, or keying by (accountId, id))
   is T-292's.
3. **Orphan dirty items from 3.1.0 escape every per-account query.** 3.1.0's logout and 410
   re-base deleted a clean list even when it still held an unpushed item. After the schema-9
   upgrade such items reach no account (items join through `lists`), are never pushed, never counted,
   never removed with the account, and if the list is later pulled under a different account they
   go out under that person's token. Fix: in `Migration8To9`, for every `items.listId` with no list
   row, insert a stub list owned by the migrated account: `dirty = 0`, every LWW clock 0, `deleted =
   true` at clock 0 (hidden until a pull revives it with real values), `kind = shopping`, empty
   name/category order. Migration test with an orphan dirty item.
4. **A 426 on a first login dead-ends the app.** `/app-version` already told the floor check the
   server's protocol; when it is **above** `PROTOCOL_VERSION`, `/login` will be refused with 426 and
   `AccountSessions.unboundOutdated` then blocks the whole app for the process with no server to
   offer the update from (`UpdateChecker.hasServer()` is false). Fix: `checkServerProtocol` throws
   `AppTooOldException(protocol, downloadUrl)` when the server's protocol is above ours; the login
   screen shows "This app is too old for this server" with a Download button when a URL came
   back; delete `unboundOutdated` (a 426 in the race between check and login is an ordinary
   `client_outdated` error on the screen).
5. **A 200 non-JSON answer to `/app-version` crashes the login screen.** A captive portal or a
   host that answers every GET with HTML makes the decoder throw `SerializationException`, which
   neither catch in `LoginViewModel.submit` handles. Fix: in `checkServerProtocol`, a decoding failure
   or a 404 without `protocol` (T-297) is `NotATuppuServerException`; the screen shows "No Tuppu
   server answered at this address." `login_msg_server_too_old` stays for a protocol below the
   floor. Three login messages in total, nine locales each.

## P3, fix in the same pass

6. Stale 401: `onUnauthorized` acts only if the token the request carried equals the account's
   current token (`secrets.token(id)`); the sent token is on the request the interceptor sees.
7. Forced logout finishes in core: `onUnauthorized` also deletes the token (`secrets.setToken(id,
   null)`), so a background 401 does not leave a dead token that `AuthInterceptor` keeps sending.
   The synced-row cleanup stays in `clearLocalSession`.
8. `signedIn` without a token: `KeystoreSecretStore.setToken` uses `commit()`; `SyncEngine` treats
   a signed-in account with no token as not eligible (and marks it `signedIn = false`).
9. `AccountDao.upsert`: Room's `@Upsert` turns a UNIQUE-index conflict on (serverUrl, accountId)
   into an UPDATE by primary key that matches nothing, so the row is silently dropped while the
   registry's copy keeps it. Use `@Insert(onConflict = ABORT)` + `@Update`; the registry surfaces
   the conflict. Test it.
10. Remove or logout during an in-flight sync: a per-account `Mutex` (owned by `AccountSessions` or
    the registry) held by `syncAccount`, `clearLocalSession` and `remove`; `syncNow`'s catch must not
    recreate a removed account's `SyncState` (check the account still exists before `failed`).
11. `syncNow`'s per-account exception isolation has no test (a `throw e` mutation passes). Add one.
12. Canonical server URL: `normalizeServerUrl` lowercases scheme and host, drops a default port,
    keeps the path, ensures the trailing slash. "Same account" (T-260) and the migration use it.
13. Device-level last server URL: keep `ServerConfig.serverUrl` (and the debug-only self-signed
    flag) as "the address last typed", saved on every submit as in 3.1.0. The login screen prefills
    from it, the T-276 check uses it, and it survives a failed attempt, a deleted account and an
    upgrade with a URL but no session. `discardLegacy` then removes nothing from ServerConfig; the
    migration still reads it. Fix the LoginViewModelTest that only passed because the fake stored a
    write the real shim drops.
14. `DefaultCurrencyState` derives from `registry.accounts` (the current account's row), not from
    one read at construction.
15. `UpdateChecker` asks `/app-version` through `sessions.unbound(url, flag)` (no bearer token on an
    unauthenticated endpoint) and refreshes `serverProtocol` from a 404 body too (T-297).
16. `removeOtherAccounts` and `SyncEngine.syncAccount` filter/guard on `isServer` (a local account,
    B3, must never be removed by a login or handed to `sessions.get`).
17. Dead code: `ItemDao/ListDao.deleteSyncedRows()`, `ListDao.anyActiveListId()`,
    `ListDao.idsForAccount()`; the double `DeviceIdProvider` route (`ServerConfig` implements it AND
    `DeviceIdModule` wraps it): keep one. Stale names: `Syncer` KDoc mentions DataStore;
    `SessionStoreRecoveryTest` → `KeystoreSecretStoreRecoveryTest`; `LoginViewModelTest`'s
    `serverConfig` variables; `ListEntity.accountId` KDoc says "which server"; `SyncStatus` KDoc claims
    account order but it is insertion order (say so or sort by the registry's order).
18. Tests: a unit test of `RegistryCurrentAccount`'s rules (first *server* account, token only when
    signed in, a write with no account is dropped); `RootViewModelTest` cancels the view model;
    `registry.flush()` in the tearDown of tests that trigger background writes.

## Docs

19. `docs/wire-contract.md`: floor table "Since" names a release (the next one), the floor paragraph
    says "whenever the app holds no protocol at or above the floor for that server" rather than
    "first sign-in", and the `/app-version` + `no_app_package` text matches T-297.
20. `android/README.md`: the Robolectric sentence (several `:core` tests live in `:app` only for a
    Context); rewrap the update paragraph. AGENTS.md: move the stale-Hilt note out of the Robolectric
    list into its own build bullet.
21. T-295 gets the B5 blocker table from the review as a note (UUID, currentTimeMillis, ConcurrentHashMap,
    synchronized, java.net.URI, java.text.Normalizer, IOException/SSLException, javaClass, @ConstructedBy;
    AppFormat/AppLocale back to :app; the design's interface names vs the code's).
title: B1 review follow-ups: atomic login, orphan items, shared list rows, 426 dead end, non-JSON crash, per-account mutex, canonical URL, docs
